company: WANT WANT CHINA HOLDINGS LTD HONG KONG
description: Want Want China Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of food and beverages. It operates through four segments: Rice Crackers, Dairy Products and Beverages, Snack Foods, and Other Products. The Rice Crackers segment offers sugar coated, savoury, and fried crackers, as well as gift packs. The Dairy Products and Beverages segment provides flavored milk, yogurt, yogurt drinks, ready-to-drink coffee, juice and sports drinks, herbal tea, and milk powder.
